response.sql: WITH per_order AS (SELECT ordersmark, AVG(fillcount) AS avg_fill FROM orderexecutions GROUP BY ordersmark), first_benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(avg_fill) AS benchmark FROM per_order), first_pass AS (SELECT p.avg_fill, p.avg_fill - b.benchmark AS first_excess FROM per_order p CROSS JOIN first_benchmark b WHERE p.avg_fill > b.benchmark), second_benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(avg_fill) AS benchmark FROM first_pass) SELECT AVG(f.avg_fill) AS avg_fill_quantity, AVG(f.first_excess) AS avg_first_excess, AVG(f.avg_fill - s.benchmark) AS avg_second_excess FROM first_pass f CROSS JOIN second_benchmark s WHERE f.avg_fill > s.benchmark;
